features.rationale: The event offers 45 hours of dance classes across three levels, which are workshops.

features.quote: 3 parties until dawn in 3 different rooms
features.rationale: The parties take place in three different rooms, so there is more than one dance floor.
An SBK Pre-Party is scheduled before the main party on Friday and Saturday.
The SBK Social Happy Hour is an afternoon social held from 5:30 PM.
